title: High Quality Segmentation for Ultra High-resolution Images (CRM)
mechanism: Continuous Refinement Model: an implicit-function refiner that aligns features to the refinement target and can output at any resolution.
evidence: R: claims generalisation across the low-res training / ultra-high-res test gap (abstract, no numbers on page).
adaptation: Query at 2x or 4x output resolution to model sub-pixel crack position and source-specific width, then downsample; tests whether width / alignment error is a resolution problem.
min_experiment: Arm: CRM-style implicit refiner at 2x output. Baseline: house ensemble. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@1 and @2. Kill: crack IoU < +0.012.
prior_overlap: 2x input resolution n.d.; implicit super-resolved output not run.
